description: Create a new security policy in Eramba with the following details: Name 'Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) Policy', Description 'This policy establishes guidelines for employees who use personal devices to access company data and systems, ensuring security controls are in place to protect organizational information.', Status 'Draft'. Navigate to the Policies section in the left sidebar, click 'New Policy' or the '+' button, fill in the name, description, and set the status to Draft, then save the policy.
